name: Lingering Taste of Oil
source:
A recollection of all the subtle ways passion can burn you. A memory of the best time of your life. A record mentally kept in the hopes that someday, if you think back to it, it'll all make sense. 

[From [url=https://indecisiv.itch.io/lingering-taste-of-oil]itch.io[/url]]
